analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to access a demo version of [product_name] software because it has been temporarily removed from the official download location. This leads to uncertainty and dependence on others for access, highlighting a lack of communication and alternative download options during product downtime.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects uninterrupted access or an alternative source for the demo version, even when official channels are unavailable. There is also a desire for clearer and more helpful communication regarding availability status.
